mathematical_meanings: Left image: The hollow circle excludes the ordered pair at the right endpoint of the segment. Right image: The outline is the circumference of the circle whose diameter is AB.
Rationales: The feature marks an ordered pair excluded from the plotted trace in the left image and traces the circumference of a geometric circle in the right image. The hollow circle at the lower right end of the short descending segment. The circular outline through A, B and C.
